sacred.mantra:
Hare Krishna Hare Krishna
Krishna Krishna Hare Hare
Hare Rama Hare Rama
Rama Rama Hare Hare
sacred.purification: Om. Whether impure or pure, in any state, one who remembers the lotus-eyed Lord is purified within and without.
